title: Meta must pay and change its apps – level 1
paragraphs: The company Meta must pay 18 billion dollars (16.5 billion euros) to 48 US states. US leaders say Facebook and Instagram are bad for children’s health.

Meta says that it does nothing wrong, but it will pay the money over ten years. Meta is also changing how teenagers use its apps. Teenagers will only use the apps for two hours a day. The apps will stop working at night and during school time. Meta also wants to hide the number of likes.
Meta wants other video apps like TikTok and YouTube to make the same changes for children, too. People are asking how safe these apps are for children.
